metadata.title: Combining machine translation and automated scoring in international large-scale assessments

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not model plausible values-based achievement as it focuses on dichotomous item scoring.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses student-level models without accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through cross-validation and train/test splits.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “We analyzed the multilingual student responses involving eight countries and six different languages… The item-by-country sample sizes are shown in Table 1.”
design_fields._q2_audit: Source checked; original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights in its analysis.
